lessons.title: 1. Hello C++ & std::string
lessons.description: Welcome to C++! C++ is a powerful compiled language. Implement `get_language()` returning `std::string("C++")`.

lessons.title: 2. Integers & Arithmetic
lessons.description: In C++, integer calculations use fundamental types like `int`. Implement `calculate_total(int price, int quantity)`.
learning_objectives: Use int primitive arithmetic in C++

lessons.title: 3. Rocket Payload Fuel Calculator (Concept Challenge)
lessons.description: Calculate required rocket fuel mass in C++.
learning_objectives: Combine double variables and floating point math in C++

lessons.title: 4. Circle Area Calculator (Practice)
lessons.description: Calculate circle area using pi * radius * radius.

lessons.title: 5. Unit 1 Checkpoint: C++ Variables Mastery
